say:0:1310101001:0.text: Wow... look at the snow at dusk. It's so beautiful!
say:0:1310101001:0.source_cn: 哇……黄昏的雪景，真是美丽！

say:1:1310101002:0.source_cn: 风声吹拂，鸟儿在雪中沉思，真是宁静又平和的风景。

say:0:1310102001:0.text: It's snowing! Wanna build a snowman?
say:0:1310102001:0.source_cn: 下雪了！好想堆个雪人玩！

say:1:1310102002:0.text: The last time I saw snow was in Ryeham.
say:1:1310102002:0.source_cn: 上次见到下雪，还是在金穗村呢。

say:0:1310103001:0.text: Whoa, looks like someone up ahead's surrounded by wild animals!
say:0:1310103001:0.source_cn: 哇嚯，前面好像有人被野兽包围了。

say:2:1310105001:0.text: I was scared out of my mind back there. I really thought I was done for...
say:2:1310105001:0.source_cn: 刚才可真是吓死我了……还以为我这次要死在路上了……

say:3:1310105002:0.text: I've been down this road over a dozen times, and I've never seen it this dangerous!
say:3:1310105002:0.source_cn: 这条路我走了十六七回，这么危险还是第一次！

say:4:1310105003:0.text: Honestly, if it weren't for the <style="highlight">Snowspire Festival</style>, who'd come to Whiteridge in this freezing weather?

say:5:1310105004:0.text: Oh, I almost forgot to thank you. Sorry, I get really chatty when I'm nervous...
say:5:1310105004:0.source_cn: 哎呀，忘了谢谢你们了。我一紧张就话多……

choice_prompt:6:1310105004.text: Oh, I almost forgot to thank you. Sorry, I get really chatty when I'm nervous...
choice_prompt:6:1310105004.source_cn: 哎呀，忘了谢谢你们了。我一紧张就话多……

say:7:1310105005:0.text: Don't be so modest. You saved my life! So I'm guessing you're headed to the festival too?
say:7:1310105005:0.source_cn: 不，这不是客气，你们真的救了我的命啊！你们……看样子像...

say:8:1310105006:0.text: Yup! It's our first time here.
say:8:1310105006:0.source_cn: 对呀，我们是第一次来呢。

say:9:1310105012:1.text: Since we're all heading to <style="highlight">Cedartown</style> for the festival, why don't we stick together?

say:12:1310105013:0.text: Oho! We can keep you safe. No need to fret about wild animals or pesky bandits with us around!
say:12:1310105013:0.source_cn: 嚯哈哈，有我们几个在，你也不用担心什么野兽和强盗了。

say:13:1310105014:0.text: That's great! I was starting to worry about the road ahead.
say:13:1310105014:0.source_cn: 那太好了！大家都顺路，正好我也在担心后面的路该怎么走呢。

say:14:1310105015:1.text: In return for keeping me safe, I can be your guide when we get there.
say:14:1310105015:1.source_cn: 等到了雪松镇，我可以给你们做向导，带你们好好逛一逛。

choice_prompt:15:1310105015.text: In return for keeping me safe, I can be your guide when we get there.
choice_prompt:15:1310105015.source_cn: 等到了雪松镇，我可以给你们做向导，带你们好好逛一逛。

say:16:1310105016:0.text: Not to brag, but I know Cedartown like the back of my hand. I know everything about that town! Let me tell ya...
say:16:1310105016:0.source_cn: 这可不是我说大话，我去雪松镇就像回自家一样。镇上有什么...

say:17:1310105017:0.text: Ahem! Now, let's get a wiggle on, shall we? It'll be dark before we know it!
say:17:1310105017:0.source_cn: 咳，还是先赶路吧，等会就要天黑了。

say:18:1310105018:0.text: Oh right, there's still a long way to go. Let's walk and I'll tell you all about Cedartown.
say:18:1310105018:0.source_cn: 啊对，还得走好一段路呢。咱们先走吧，路上我再跟你们好好...

say:20:1310105007:0.text: Are you going as well? That's great!
say:20:1310105007:0.source_cn: 对呀，你们也是？那太巧了。

say:21:1310105008:0.text: I'm mainly here for the festival, but I'm also stocking up on goods from Whiteridge to sell.
say:21:1310105008:0.source_cn: 我这次主要就是为了祭典，顺便收购些白山特产回去卖。

say:22:1310105009:0.text: Haha, I'm just a small-time trader. I came to buy some local specialties.
say:22:1310105009:0.source_cn: 嗐，我就是个小商人，来白山收购些本地特产。

say:23:1310105010:0.text: But besides that, I'm also here for the Snowspire Festival. You've heard of it, right?
say:23:1310105010:0.source_cn: 当然啦，这回除了进货，也是来参加祭典的，哎，冬日祭典你...

say:24:1310105011:0.text: Of course! The festival is why we're here!
say:24:1310105011:0.source_cn: 当然，我们也是来参加祭典的！

narration:0:1310108101:0.text: Everyone works together to clear the boulder blocking the path.
narration:0:1310108101:0.source_cn: 众人齐心协力，搬开了堵住小路的落石

say:0:1310109001:0.text: Awesome! We can get through now!
say:0:1310109001:0.source_cn: 太好了！入口清理出来了！

say:1:1310109002:0.text: Stay close, everyone. Don't get separated.
say:1:1310109002:0.source_cn: 大家跟紧点，可别走散了。

say:0:1310112001:0.text: Oh no, a hornleaf bear! Looks like we wandered into its den!
say:0:1310112001:0.source_cn: 糟糕，是雪地叶角熊，我们好像闯到它的巢穴里了！

say:0:1310113001:0.text: We're almost there. See? Just down this slope.
say:0:1310113001:0.source_cn: 快到了，瞧，从这里下去就绕过雪崩的地方了。

say:1:1310113002:0.text: Wait, we climbed all the way up here, and now we have to go back down?
say:1:1310113002:0.source_cn: 啊？好不容易爬上来，现在又要下去？

say:0:1310114001:0.text: There's a cabin up ahead. Let's see if we can rest there.
say:0:1310114001:0.source_cn: 我们在前面的猎人小屋休整一下吧。

say:0:1310115001:0.text: Hello there! The sun's setting. You shouldn't be out at night.
say:0:1310115001:0.source_cn: 朋友，将要日落了，最好别在外面行走。
say:0:1310115001:0.male: Hello there! The sun's setting. You shouldn't be out at night.
say:0:1310115001:0.female: Hello there! The sun's setting. You shouldn't be out at night.

say:3:1310116001:0.text: Oh my, it's a white wolf! Are you a Mauler, sir?
say:3:1310116001:0.source_cn: 呀，是位白狼先生！白狼先生，你是蛮血部落的人吗？

say:4:1310116002:0.text: Good evening. I am Faramor, hailing from the Wilder faction, not the Maulers.
say:4:1310116002:0.source_cn: 诸位，夜安。我是临湾地的法拉莫尔，来自绿裔联盟，而非蛮...

say:5:1310116003:1.text: Dura above! I've never seen a Wilder who looks like you before!
say:5:1310116003:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，你居然是绿裔，我还从来没见过你这样的绿裔成员呢。

say:6:1310116004:0.text: Humans vary greatly, and so do Wilders. Take these two familiars, for instance—both hamsters, yet utterly distinct in temperament.
say:6:1310116004:0.source_cn: 人类的相貌性格各有不同，绿裔自然也一样。\n就像这二位...

say:9:1310116005:0.text: Wow! You knew we were familiars!
say:9:1310116005:0.source_cn: 哇！你居然认出我们是使魔！

say:10:1310116006:0.text: For once, someone didn't just assume we're regular hamsters!
say:10:1310116006:0.source_cn: 呀！你竟然觉得我们不是老鼠！

say:12:1310116008:1.text: Haha, you two make quite the duo. Since you are familiars, I take it this is your master?

say:12:1310116008:1.male: Haha, you two make quite the duo. Since you are familiars, I take it this is your master?
say:12:1310116008:1.female: Haha, you two make quite the duo. Since you are familiars, I take it this is your master?

say:16:1310116011:0.text: The dangers of the night are beyond what you can fathom.

say:16:1310116011:0.male: The dangers of the night are beyond what you can fathom.
say:16:1310116011:0.female: The dangers of the night are beyond what you can fathom.

say:20:1310116014:0.text: Never... go out in the dark?

say:21:1310116015:0.text: Indeed. In this region, the <style="highlight">undead</style> frequently emerge under the cover of darkness, attacking anything that breathes.

say:23:1310116016:0.text: Yes. They act without rhyme or reason, indiscriminately targeting the living. The people of Whiteridge are gripped by fear at the very thought of them.

say:27:1310116019:0.source_cn: 身体腐朽，活动自由……这听上去很像亡灵啊？

say:30:1310116021:1.text: Right! We've seen the Graveborn experimenting on humans before, turning them into mindless creatures. Could the undead have come from something like that?
say:30:1310116021:1.source_cn: 对哦，我们曾见过亡灵用人做实验，把人变成了失去理智的亡...

say:31:1310116023:0.text: Experimenting on humans and turning them into mindless creatures? That is abhorrent!
say:31:1310116023:0.source_cn: 用人做实验？把人变成没有理智的亡灵？这太残忍了！

say:32:1310116024:0.text: Yet, these undead have been present here for centuries, and their numbers are vast. It hardly seems likely they are mere experiment subjects.
say:32:1310116024:0.source_cn: 不过这里的活死人从很早以前就存在了，而且数量非常多，并...

say:33:1310116025:0.text: In any case, most of the Graveborn we've met weren't exactly good people. Some were cold-blooded, others bloodthirsty maniacs, and some were sneaky schemers hiding in the shadows!
say:33:1310116025:0.source_cn: 总而言之，我们见过的亡灵大多都不是什么好人。有的残忍冷...

say:34:1310116026:0.text: Nature may bless us with goodness, but there will always be those that defy it, creatures born of malice... I cannot fully comprehend it, but perhaps that is simply the nature of the Graveborn.
say:34:1310116026:0.source_cn: 大自然赋予我们善念，当然也就会有违背自然规律的恶意作祟...

say:35:1310116027:0.text: Ah, that brings something to mind—there is a peculiar quality to the undead here in Whiteridge. I am most eager to uncover their origins and, with any luck, find a way to rid us of them, once and for all.
say:35:1310116027:0.source_cn: 说起来，我一直觉得白山的活死人很特殊，希望能找到它们确...

say:36:1310116028:0.text: I've perused the archives at Whiteridge Temple and consulted with the acolytes, but their knowledge is unfortunately limited.
say:36:1310116028:0.source_cn: 我曾多次前往白山大教堂查阅典籍、询问这里的修士，但他们...

say:37:1310116029:0.text: All they know is that the undead have plagued this region for over a thousand years. Even with your extensive experience, I would still urge you to exercise caution in this place.
say:37:1310116029:0.source_cn: 尽管你们对付亡灵的经验已经很丰富，在这里也还是小心一点为好。

say:38:1310116030:0.text: We will! Thank you for the warning, sir.
say:38:1310116030:0.source_cn: 我们会的，谢谢你的提醒，法拉莫尔先生。

say:39:1310116031:0.text: The night is dark, and the snow is relentless. You should remain here until dawn. There is a hunter's cabin just ahead where you may take shelter, though it may not be large enough for all of you...
say:39:1310116031:0.source_cn: 天黑雪急，诸位就在此过夜吧。前面有座空的猎人小屋，那里...

say:40:1310116032:0.text: However, if it pleases you, Magister, I would be honored to offer you, your two familiars, and your dwarven companion a place at my home. It is modest, but cozy enough for everyone.
say:40:1310116032:0.source_cn: 如果不介意的话，魔法师大人、矮人先生和两位使魔可以住在...

say:41:1310116033:0.source_cn: 大家请随意，但记得，晚上千万不要出门！

say:43:1310116022:0.text: Wait, Chippy just remembered—Viperian! His experiments turn people into mindless creatures!
say:43:1310116022:0.source_cn: 满满想起来了，维珀里安！他的实验就会把人变成没有理智的亡灵！

say:44:1310116017:0.text: Are you thinking of that children's story about rotting avengers prowling the night? I admit, it does carry that air, but this is no folktale—it's the grim truth.
say:44:1310116017:0.source_cn: 黑夜中的腐朽复仇者？确实很像，但这是真的，不是民间故事。

say:4:1310119002:0.text: "Curse of the Reborn", "Collection of Horrors", "The Genesis of Death", and "Shackles of Life: A Deluxe Edition"...
say:4:1310119002:0.source_cn: 《复生者之咒》、《恐厄集》、《死诞之书》……还有精装版...

say:5:1310119003:0.text: These books are all about the Graveborn. Faramor really knows his stuff.

say:7:1310119005:0.source_cn: 满满，怎么能随便看别人的信件呢！

say:8:1310119006:0.source_cn: 对不起……可满满也不是故意的，这封信就这么放在桌子上……

say:22:1310139017:1.source_cn: 但是，满满可不想再坐船了，满满还是喜欢脚踏实地前进！

say:24:1310139019:1.source_cn: 各位，希望你们这次路途顺利。

say:28:1310139004:1.text: Thank Dura you're safe! Did your ship run aground because of the rough waves?

say:1:1310140001:1.text: Hello! You're a merchant from the Mithril Consortium, right? We have a question for you.
say:1:1310140001:1.source_cn: 你好，你是秘银商会的商人吧？请问……

say:2:1310140002:1.text: *Muttering* Ah, right, this is supposed to be delivered to the Moonlit Enclave... Huh? Oh, is there something you need?
say:2:1310140002:1.source_cn: 嗯，没错，这批货应该是送到月影邻地的……呃？你们有什么...

say:4:1310140003:1.text: Are there any carriages heading to Cedartown? It's gotta be a carriage, by the way. NO ships!
say:4:1310140003:1.source_cn: 圣石镇有通往雪松镇的驿车吗？注意，一定要是车，不能是船！

say:5:1310140004:1.text: Cedartown... Oh, in the Duchy of Whiteridge! Setting out now means you're off to the Snowspire Festival, right?
say:5:1310140004:1.source_cn: 雪松镇……唔，白山公国啊！这时节出发，是要去参加冬日祭...

say:6:1310140005:1.text: You wish to travel by land? That's definitely an option. In fact, it's actually faster to travel by land than by sea.
say:6:1310140005:1.source_cn: 你们打算走陆路？也不是不行。其实单论距离，走陆路去雪松...

say:8:1310140007:1.text: No worries about walking! Getting to Whiteridge is what matters.

say:9:1310140008:1.text: Gotcha. I'll go arrange a carriage for you. Don't worry, I'll make sure you get there before the festival begins!
say:9:1310140008:1.source_cn: 既然这样，那我就去安排驿车了。放心，一定在祭典开幕前把...

say:10:1310140009:1.text: Come find me when you're ready.
say:10:1310140009:1.source_cn: 你们准备好了就来找我吧。

say:1:1310141001:0.text: Are you ready to head to the Duchy of Whiteridge?
say:1:1310141001:0.source_cn: 各位朋友，准备好踏上去白山公国的旅程了吗？

say:3:1310141002:1.source_cn: 那么这就出发了！祝各位一路顺风！

say:20:1310108010:0.source_cn: 危险？嘿，有我们几个在，危险的应该是那些野兽才对。

say:22:1310108011:0.source_cn: 他们从野兽手里救了我，我保证，矮人大师这句话没有一点儿...

say:23:1310108012:0.text: Alright, let's take the small path. I hope we make it safely. Where is it?

say:33:1310108016:0.text: With those itty-bitty muscles...? Looks like we won't reach Cedartown any time soon... But hey, as long as we roll in before the festival kicks off, we're good!

say:10:1310118005:0.text: Uh... well... don't laugh! It's been a rough day, and Chippy's starving! Faramor, once the soup's done, Chippy's having a whole bowl!
say:10:1310118005:0.source_cn: 哎呀……这个……不准笑！今天真的很累很饿！法拉莫尔先生...

narration:11:1310118006:0.text: You sit around the fire eating the warm soup and feel the day's exhaustion melt away...
narration:11:1310118006:0.source_cn: 汤煮好了，你们围坐在火炉边吃了热乎乎的炖汤，感觉一整天...

say:29:1310118013:0.text: No! Remain here. Do whatever you wish, but do not venture outside.
say:29:1310118013:0.source_cn: 不行！你们呆在这里，随便做什么都可以，但绝不要出门。

say:30:1310118014:0.text: Our magister's super strong, and we're tough too. We can handle the undead!

say:34:1310118018:1.source_cn: 不能再耽误时间了，你们在这里等我回来！

say:37:1310118019:0.source_cn: 等等，法拉莫尔先生！你说的话是什么意思——？！

say:40:1310118021:0.text: The wind outside is picking up. We should stay inside for now.
say:40:1310118021:0.source_cn: 窗外的风声也更大了，我们还是先在屋里等等吧。

say:41:1310118022:0.text: Maybe we can pass the time by looking at Faramor's collection, or reading some books.
